title: CI/CD Pipelines
intro: CI/CD interview questions cover the pipelines that ship every modern Java backend — GitHub Actions vs Jenkins vs GitLab CI, declarative Jenkins pipelines, secret management, deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, rolling, feature flags), trunk-based development, automated rollback on SLO regression, and the production debugging questions interviewers love ("the pipeline is suddenly 4x slower — what now?"). For Terraform/IaC questions, see the dedicated Terraform page; for Jenkins-specific deep dives, see the Jenkins page.
